name: Viewer comment to reply to
description: A white social-media comment card pops up in the upper third over the speaker: round avatar with an initial, bold @username, the comment text (up to three lines) and a heart with a like count that ticks up and turns orange as the heart gets tapped; an optional orange chip above it reads like 'Reply to @user's comment'.
use_when: When the speaker answers or reacts to a viewer: 'someone commented…', 'a lot of you asked…', 'replying to this comment', quoting a question, a hater or a DM.

text.help: the comment itself; wraps to up to 3 lines

likes.help: like count such as '248' or '1.2K'; counts up if it is a number; empty = no count

label.help: optional chip above the card, e.g. "Reply to @sam's comment"
